_notes.players[2..3]: Not in C. Round 1 P3 lime #a8f03c / P4 magenta #e45cff (DS-Foundations.dc.html L255, L280) kept as hue families (green, violet) and rebuilt with C's recipe: ring = mid-light, tint = same hue near-white, digit = same hue dark (~5.3:1 on its tint, like C P1/P2). Lightness is spread on purpose: ring luminance P4 0.28 < P2 0.43 < P1 0.49 < P3 0.64, so P3 and P4 differ from each other and from P1/P2 in lightness, not only in hue. P3 moved from lime toward green (hue 84 > 106) and softened so it does not read as the gold accent; P4 moved from magenta toward violet (hue 290 > 262) so it is far from danger red and the legend pink. See _cvd.
_notes.players[2..3].tint: P3/P4 tints are deliberately darker than C's pale P1/P2 tints (luminance 0.73/0.68 vs 0.86/0.84). With pale tints (e.g. #e0f5d6 / #eae1fa) the P2 and P3 tints become identical for deuteranopes (dE 1.0); with these they stay apart (min dE 7.6 across all vision types). Digits on them still pass 4.5:1.

_notes.size.touch: Spec 22 asks for touch targets of at least 44px. OPEN CONFLICT (needs Moshe): C's single-row keypad gives keys of 36x60 and the 9x9 board gives cells of 38x38; neither can reach 44 in width inside a 358px board/row. Round 1 had the same limits (keys 36x56, cells 38). Until decided: keep the full 60px key height hittable, use the 4px gaps as part of each key's hit area (hitSlop 2), and treat the board/keypad as the documented exception; every other control stays >= 44x44.

_notes._contrast: WCAG 2.x relative luminance. Required 4.5:1 for text under 24px, 3:1 for text >= 24px and for non-text (3:1, WCAG 1.4.11). Board digits are held to 4.5 even at 22px. Alpha colors are flattened over the surface they sit on (bgComposite). Disabled controls (opacity 0.3/0.4) are exempt.
adjusted: board.wrongDigit: C #ff4d5e (3.1:1 on cell) > #b8102f (>= 4.65:1 on every cell and tint).
onDanger: round 1 white (3.24:1 on C danger) > #0f1218 (5.75:1); recommended outlined danger button instead (spec 6.6).
players[2..3]: round 1 lime/magenta rebuilt for C with spread lightness and darker tints for color-blind separation (see _cvd).
Rubik 600 added to the font load (C uses weight 600 for givens but did not load it).
textFaint: C #677086 (3.78:1) > #828ba1 (>= 4.55:1 on bg/surface/surface2); C value kept as iconFaint for non-text.
lockEdge (new, recommended): 1px digit-color edge inside the lock ring, because bright seat rings are below 3:1 on the light board.
keypad keyBorder: re-measured over the key's own fill (surface2), which is what the border is drawn on: 3.02:1, passes 3:1 (it was measured over bg).

_cvd.method: Machado 2009 color-vision-deficiency simulation (severity 1.0) in linear RGB, then CIEDE2000 between every pair. Shapes ● ▲ ■ ◆ are the primary cue; color is the second cue. Rough guide: dE < 3 hard to tell apart, 5-10 visible side by side, > 10 clear.
